question: Does task-family augmentation regularize block11H3 DAS into a stable shared causal direction, or do two cue families require a genuinely two-dimensional operational subspace?

prior_art_search.result: No prior fit pools distinct cue families inside the closure-valid H3 component. The frozen-axis red team found two sharply different basins: unregularized/noise axes outperform DIM-like KL/aligned axes on future/past, while the reverse held on the earlier Later/Previously A2 panel.
prior_art_search.novelty: This is the first task-augmented fit and the first prospective test of whether cue-specific rank-one axes form a reusable rank-two causal subspace on a third unseen cue family.

frozen_design.fit_population: All A1 and A2 rows from the already-open Later/Previously v1 and future/past v2 banks, pooled before fitting. V2 is training data here, never confirmatory evidence.
frozen_design.sealed_test: All rows from the untouched next/prior-stage v3 bank. No v3 outcome changes any fit, basis, threshold, or terminal.

methods.single_task_unregularized: The previously frozen Later/Previously scalar cDAS rank-one axis.
methods.pooled_dim: Difference in means on all pooled v1+v2 A1+A2 activation deltas.
methods.pooled_aligned_rank1: One rank-one axis initialized at pooled DIM and optimized for 100 Adam steps at lr 0.03 on scalar match/complement plus 0.3 times centered full-vocabulary match/complement.
methods.two_task_dim_union_rank2: The orthonormal span of the separate v1 and v2 DIM axes; no outcome optimization. This is a matched operational falsifier for the universal rank-one claim, not a compression result.

frozen_design.selection: None. Rank 1 and the rank-2 union are both frozen by hypothesis; v3 is opened once.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_closure_and_: Authorities hold; each sealed panel has at least 75% native base and donor accuracy; full-rank closure <=1e-4; values finite; price within the registered maximum.
predictions.pred_b_task_augmentation_beats_single_ta: Pooled aligned rank 1 has lower full-vocabulary joint error than the frozen single-task unregularized axis on both sealed panels.
predictions.pred_c_optimization_beats_pooled_dim: Pooled aligned rank 1 has lower full-vocabulary joint error than pooled DIM on both sealed panels.
predictions.pred_d_rank2_union_identifies_shared_sub: The rank-2 union has lower full-vocabulary joint error than every rank-one method on both panels and complement fraction magnitude <=0.30 in scalar effect on both panels.
predictions.pred_e_rank2_improvement_is_behavioral: The rank-2 union scalar joint error is lower than every rank-one method on both panels and its subspace effect is donorward on at least 90% of rows in each panel.

decision: shared_rank1 if A,B,C pass and rank 1 is no worse than rank 2; shared_rank2 if A,D,E pass; task_conditioned if A passes but neither shared claim passes; invalid if A fails. A rank-2 pass identifies an operational subspace only inside H3 and still requires downstream reader/weight translation.
